name: FED 5302
title: Field Seminar II
description: This seminar helps students prepare for and make optimum use of their field education experience. Areas of seminar content include such topics as the roles and responsibilities of the student within the agency setting, exploration and development of learning contracts, and the educational assessment of self as a learner in the profession.  The seminar identifies issues that arise in the field and ways to deal with them.  Required course for students in the M.S.W. program.
